import json, subprocess, sys
# parser robustness: whitespace, key order, unicode-escaped keys
req = {"epoch":7,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4},{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":4}],"commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":4,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],"failed_edges":[],"budget":1}
variants = [
 ("pretty", json.dumps(req, indent=4, separators=(",", " : "))),
 ("reordered keys", '{"budget":1,"failed_edges":[],"commodities":[{"previous":[16,0],"paths":[[1],[0]],"demand":4,"target":1,"source":0}],"edges":[{"capacity":4,"head":1,"tail":0},{"capacity":4,"head":1,"tail":0}],"node_count":2,"epoch":7}'),
 ("unicode-escaped key", json.dumps(req).replace('"epoch"','"\\u0065poch"')),
 ("huge whitelist spaces", "   \t " + json.dumps(req) + " \n\t ".replace("\n","")),
]
lines = "\n".join(v for _, v in variants) + "\n"
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"], input=lines.encode(), capture_output=True)
outs = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
for (name, _), o in zip(variants, outs):
    r = json.loads(o)
    print("%-22s -> %s mlu=%s" % (name, r["status"], r.get("mlu")), flush=True)
# also: same request, keys escaped both ways (duplicate key detection)
dup = '{"epoch":7, "\\u0065poch":8, "node_count":2, "edges":[], "commodities":[], "failed_edges":[], "budget":0}'
# note: paths/commodities empty so this is otherwise valid; duplicate key makes it invalid
lines2 = dup + "\n"
p2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"], input=lines2.encode(), capture_output=True)
print("duplicate escaped-key ->", p2.stdout.decode().strip())
EOF
cd /app/work && for s in 9001 9002 9003 9004 9005 9006 9007 9008; do python campaign.py $s; done 2>&1 | tail -10
